notes.title: Update June 24
notes.notes:
1.Modify the gamepad control,adding a shoot button on gamepad control.Some charge weapon will more easy to control with gamepad.
2.Fix bug: Some boss not drop the reward item.
3.Fix bug: Stuck on the wall bug.
===================================
1. Reduced room size, increased Rover moving speed.
2. Increase the droprate of hypercores, reduce some of the cost.
3. Unify the game view, now the view has enough observation space, while ensuring a sufficient range of view movement.
4. Optimize the dismantling system,now holding press the action button can  dismantle the items on field directly,on item menu holding press the item icons also can  dismantle the item.
5. Cancel the probe sensor plugin, the Explorer provides the upgrade probe radar service now.
6. Added a bullet collision flashing tips on Rover.Please give more feedback about this.
7. Added a snow scene,continue to optimize the rich elements of the scene content in the future.

4.Lightning Barrier rebound bullets from enemy will bounce back to the enemy with 3 multiple damage.
5.All bullets and enemies will be destroy when bossed dead.
6.Fix the bug about can't get the Dodge Master Achievement.
